name: core-deep
description: The core loop with an engineering review after QA. Clarify, research and plan, build in parallel, judge the result as its end user, review the change as an engineer, then merge.

transitions.label: plan shown
transitions.when: the plan was shown and the user had a moment to object

transitions.label: all landed
transitions.when: every task of the round has landed

transitions.label: fix
transitions.when: a verdict is fix or pass-with-recommendations
transitions.then: every item below strong, acceptable ones included, becomes a fix task in the next round, grouped by the part of the codebase it touches; a task holding an unacceptable core item gets the strong tier

transitions.label: fix
transitions.when: a verdict is fix or pass-with-recommendations
transitions.then: every item below strong inside the run's change, acceptable ones included, becomes a fix task in the next round, grouped by the part of the codebase it touches; a task holding an unacceptable item gets the strong tier

transitions.label: reconcile
transitions.when: the base moved or the final checks fail
transitions.then: one worker merges the base into the run and resolves conflicts, or fixes the checks; the judges run again

handovers.label: brief
handovers.spec: the task, its contracts, build and test commands, the landing title, extra context files

handovers.label: report
handovers.spec: done, done with limitations or failed, with what was done, where it landed, build and tests, open issues; the host says whether it landed

handovers.label: judge
handovers.spec: the rubric, the harness and a note on what the round built

handovers.label: scored report
handovers.spec: one score and note per rubric item and an overview; the host derives the verdict

handovers.label: slice
handovers.spec: its rubric ids, its share of the product and what is shared

handovers.label: evidence
handovers.spec: what it did, saw and expected per item, with evidence paths; collected, collected with gaps or failed

handovers.label: judge
handovers.spec: the engineering rubric and a note on what the run built, the conventions the briefs pointed at and what to look at first

handovers.label: scored report
handovers.spec: one score and note per item and an overview; the host derives the verdict
